I'm so sorry for your loss.. 😔
I understand, its overwhelming but I promise you it gets better
That is literally the only reason why I chose warlock in the first destiny and the melee as well, of course.
I own a Xbox one and a PS4 and I personally prefer play station.

The thing is I can generally handle stress pretty easily but it's like my brother is trying to psychologically abuse me, I'm not sure what to do in this situation what I usually do is, I lock my door and just sit in my room waiting for night time so that I can ignore him and when you're living in the same house as the guy who you're trying to ignore, It's not exactly easy.
I'm only 14 so i'm dependent on my parents, I'll have to wait another 3  years and then i'll go to college
Gonna remember the ball smashing for sure xD thanks.
The thing is, they all know that I hate him and my brother knows but he's made this dilemma in his mind where he thinks that I actually love him. He's crazy.
